name: Dragon's Rage Channeler
oracle_text:
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card into your graveyard.)
Delirium — As long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, this creature gets +2/+2, has flying, and attacks each combat if able.
blocked_sentences: Delirium — As long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, this creature gets +2/+2, has flying, and attacks each combat if able.

needs.what: a static-legal counting leaf for the number of *distinct card types* among the cards in a zone -- the natural spelling being `{"distinct": {"of": "card_type", "objects": {"zone": "graveyard", "controller": "you"}}}`, i.e. a third `DISTINCT_OF` entry beside `power` and `basic_land_type` (src/automtg/engine/effects/values.py, DISTINCT_OF) that counts the union of `card.types` over the pool, plus admission of `distinct` into `STATIC_VALUE_KEYS` (src/automtg/cards/loader.py:3169) so a static `condition`'s `cmp` can hold it. That one leaf turns on every delirium card at once -- the printed clause is always "four or more card types among cards in your graveyard" -- and the same leaf reads "the number of card types among cards in your graveyard" on the effect side (Traverse the Ulvenwald, Emrakul's Evangel-style scaling), so it wants to land in `VALUE_KEYS` too.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `count` is the closest and is the wrong measurement: it counts *objects* matching a filter, so a graveyard of four creature cards reads 4 and satisfies a `>= 4` that delirium must reject, while a graveyard of one instant, one land, one artifact and one creature also reads 4 and passes by coincidence. That is the same distinction `values.py` already spells out for domain -- "five Forests are five and not one". `distinct` is the leaf that does count distinct values, but it is blocked twice over: its `DISTINCT_OF` allows only `power` (coven) and `basic_land_type` (domain), with no card-type entry, and it is absent from `STATIC_VALUE_KEYS` -- which is `{const, count, mana_symbols, counters_on, permanents_entered_this_turn}` plus the life and per-player leaves -- so even with a card-type entry it could not be named inside a static's `condition`. The `zone: graveyard` support in static counting filters that makes Threshold (Nimble Mongoose, `count` >= 7) and Hellbent expressible therefore reaches the graveyard but cannot ask what is in it. The remaining temptation is to enumerate: `any` of `all`-of-`exists` nodes over every 4-subset of the card types, which is 126 branches for nine types, silently wrong the moment a tenth type is printed, and an approximation rather than the sentence. Only this clause is blocked -- the first line, "Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, surveil 1", is a plain `spell_cast` trigger filtered `not_types: ["Creature"]` with the `surveil` op, and the consequences of the delirium clause (`buff` +2/+2, `grant_keyword` flying, `attacks_if_able`) are all present static effects -- so no partial answer was written.
